title: Tetris
text: Tetris is a very old video game. It is from Russia. There is a big box on the screen, and there are pieces that fall from the top.
There are seven different pieces. Each piece has four squares. There is a long piece, there is a square piece and there are pieces with the shape of the letters L, J, S, T and Z.
You can move the pieces to the left and to the right. You can also turn them. Your goal is to make full lines. When a line is full, it goes away and you get points.
The pieces fall faster and faster. If the pieces get to the top of the box, the game ends.
There is a version of Tetris on almost every computer, phone and console. There are millions of players in the world. It is simple, but it is very difficult to stop!

grammar.title: Grammar: there is / there are
grammar.rule: Use there is for one thing and there are for two or more things.
